name: Diamond Sutra scroll
summary: A Buddhist scroll of seven woodblock-printed paper sheets with a colophon dated 868, found at Dunhuang and a famous early dated printed book.
description: Seven woodblock-printed paper sheets joined into a scroll; the custodian identifies hemp and mulberry paper.
tier_reason: The scoped record is a particular configuration, local witness, trial or material application. Dependence across fields or generations on THIS referent is not established; do not inherit the importance of its broader missing family.

impact.note: One surviving printed scroll, sealed in a cave and a witness to woodblock printing, not its origin; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.

date.basis: The dated 868 colophon states the scroll was made for universal distribution; its accessibility by that time is a scoped inference from the finished exemplar and stated purpose.
